WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Written for the live game, levels 1 to 60. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40, a level later for each point spent in another tree. Talent effects are Blizzard's November 2 notes; trained ranks and costs are read from the client, build 1.60.1.70938. Blizzard has not changed Rogue since launch beyond two tooltip fixes on November 6. The builds are Icy Veins' (updated November 4), Wowhead's (November 6 and 11) and WoWSims' preset, each named. Wowhead's Subtlety overview and the text of its talent page still describe the beta tree, with Death MarkDeath MarkTalent · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost25 EnergyRange20 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration6 sec only "hinted"; only its embedded builds are used here. Nothing about level 60 is measured: no raid opens before December 9. If a tooltip on this page differs from the text, go by the text.

What Subtlety is for

Openers, bought early, and from 30 a builder that does not care where you stand. The top of the tree runs on ShankShankSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost5 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownInstantly strike with your off-hand weapon, dealing 50% weapon damage and generating 15 Energy. Shank cannot Miss.. Boot KnifeBoot KnifeTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantGrants your Shank ability a 100% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target. in row 6 gives it a 20% chance per rank, 100% at 5/5, to add 2 combo points. Death MarkDeath MarkTalent · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost25 EnergyRange20 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration6 sec, the 31-point talent, is a finisher that stores part of your damage for 6 seconds and then deals it.

Icy Veins, updated November 7, says Forever's talent changes "position it as one of the most fun and high burst specs in the game, even in PvE", and that it struggles a little until 30. Its named problem is position: before HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 EnergyRangeMeleeDuration15 secAn instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point. the damage is built around BackstabBackstabLevel 4 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeBackstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point., and "you won't be able to do so very often when leveling solo." Wowhead's levelling page, updated November 6, calls Subtlety "a very burst-focused class while leveling", built on an AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 70 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point. that almost always crits.

Stat priority

While levelling, from Icy Veins: weapon damage favouring a slow main hand, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, Attack Power, critical strike, Strength. Its example: "Between a 15 DPS weapon that has a 1.9 speed, and a 14 DPS weapon with a 2.8 speed, the 2.8 speed one will serve you better." The Wowhead and WoWSims level 60 build accepts any weapon type; a BackstabBackstabLevel 4 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeBackstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point. build needs a dagger in the main hand.

At 60 the two sites order the top differently, and both say it is early.

  • Icy Veins: weapon damage, Expertise to 6.5%, Hit to 8%, weapon skill, Agility.
  • Wowhead, which calls its own list "purely speculative for endgame": Hit to 8%, Expertise to 6.5%, weapon skill, then Hit on to 17% for poisons, Agility, critical strike.
  • WoWSims' stored weights put Expertise ahead of Hit, then Agility, critical strike and Haste. They were not retuned after the November 3 talent rework (WoWSims' model).

Icy Veins adds that enemies cannot parry you from behind, so stay behind the boss.
